narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Three g plus five h has odd numbers in it, so it is always odd.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Try g as one and h as one, and three plus five gives eight.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Eight is even, so the card is not always odd, and it can go either way.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble shows 3g + 5h always odd; g = 1, h = 1 gives 3 + 5 = 8 appears; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check a card, look for two in every part.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>If one odd result turns up, the card is not always even.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the two trays; the line look for two in every part appears; then the line one odd result means not always even

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu sees odd numbers in three g plus five h and calls it always odd. With g and h both one, it gives eight, which is even.
